title: DAILY FIGHTER — WEEK 2 DAY 8
emphasis: Foundation Thursday LOWER STRESS: symptom-adjusted planche technique, submaximal rings, posterior-chain durability, spinal-engine rotation, elastic power, and aerobic base

levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min easy mobility. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1 + 4:00 Zone 2 (20:50), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Curved-Treadmill Intervals
ignition.home: Curved treadmill: alternate brisk and easy walking
ignition.cue: RPE 5; tall posture and conversational recovery

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: PLANCHE TECHNIQUE REGRESSION
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 6. No progression today. Last qualifying planche work: 3×5 pseudo-planche push-ups on 9/14. Gate remains two clean 3×6–8 exposures ≤RPE 8 after symptoms permit.

exercises.name: Planche Lean
exercises.cue: Protract; locked elbows; stop for radiating or sharp pain

exercises.name: Hollow-Body Hold
exercises.cue: Lower back down; ribs tucked; breathe

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: SUBMAXIMAL RING STRENGTH
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; 5 RIR, RPE 6. Easy leverage and pain-free range; no load, depth, or rep progression.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.cue: Rings to ribs; body rigid; no shoulder symptoms

exercises.name: Ring Push-Up
exercises.cue: Rings quiet; ribs stacked; skip if symptoms appear

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: POSTERIOR CHAIN + SPINAL ENGINE
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; 4–5 RIR, RPE 6. Repeat Sunday’s clean lower-stress pattern without progression.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Lying Hamstring Curl
exercises.cue: Hips tall; smooth curl; no lumbar extension

exercises.name: Dopa Band Windmill Stretch
exercises.cue: Rotate through hips and upper back; own the range

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: ELASTIC POWER MECHANICS
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45; RPE 6. Stop when jump height, rhythm, landing, or posture declines.

exercises.name: Dopa Band Jump Ski Movement
exercises.cue: Fast takeoff; quiet landing; stop before slowing

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: AEROBIC ENGINE + LOWER-LEG ARMOR
deposits.effort: RPE 5–6. Zone 2 progresses duration only from 7:00 to 8:00; finish with one easy durability set.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.cue: Heels stay down; lift toes fully

martialSupplement.name: Dopa Band Reactive Guard
martialSupplement.home: Dopa Band + mat: reactive guard-retention hip-and-leg recoveries
martialSupplement.cue: Shoulders relaxed and pain-free; solo work supplements coaching
